title: Course Introduction
body: This mini-course introduces you to the Adapt e-learning framework — a free, open-source toolkit for creating responsive, accessible, multi-device HTML5 learning content.
instruction: Use the arrows to navigate through the slides.

_items.title: What is Adapt?
_items.body: Adapt is a free, open-source e-learning framework that creates fully responsive, multi-device HTML5 content. It supports SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004, xAPI, and cmi5 for LMS delivery. With 23+ bundled plugins, built-in accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), and a modular plugin architecture, Adapt gives developers and instructional designers the power to create modern, engaging e-learning experiences.

_graphic.alt: Adapt Framework displayed across multiple devices

_items.title: Authoring Tool
_items.body: The Adapt authoring tool is a web-based user interface built on Node.js, Backbone.js, and MongoDB. It allows non-technical users to create, edit, and publish Adapt courses without writing code. The authoring tool supports all core extensions and components, and allows uploading and linking of course assets through an intuitive dashboard interface.

_graphic.alt: Screenshot of the Adapt Authoring Tool interface

_items.title: Interactive Components
_items.body: Adapt comes with 23+ built-in components including accordion, narrative, flip cards, MCQ, slider, matching, text input, media, and more. Each component is fully responsive, accessible, and customizable. Extensions add course-level features like trickle (step locking), bookmarking, page-level progress, xAPI tracking, and language picking.

_graphic.alt: Animation showing Adapt narrative component in action

_items.title: What is Adapt?
_items.body: Adapt is a free, open-source e-learning framework that creates fully responsive, multi-device HTML5 content. It supports SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004, xAPI, and cmi5 for LMS delivery, and includes built-in accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA).

_items.title: Components & Plugins
_items.body: Adapt uses a modular plugin architecture. Display components (text, media, accordion, narrative, etc.) show content, while question components (MCQ, matching, text input, slider) assess learners. Extensions add course-level features like trickle, bookmarking, and page-level progress.

_items.title: Responsive Design
_items.body: Every Adapt component is fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. Layouts adjust automatically via CSS breakpoints, and images can use different resolutions for different screen sizes.

_items.title: Assessment & Tracking
_items.body: Adapt supports comprehensive assessment features including question banks, randomisation, custom scoring, and detailed feedback. SCORM/xAPI tracking captures completion status, score, and interaction data for LMS reporting.

front.title: What is Adapt?
front.body: An open-source framework, a server-based authoring tool, or a commercial LMS?

back.title: Answer
back.body: Adapt is an open-source e-learning framework for creating responsive, multi-device HTML5 content. The authoring tool is a separate product.

front.title: SCORM Support
front.body: Which SCORM versions does Adapt support?

back.title: Answer
back.body: Adapt supports SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004, xAPI, and cmi5 via the Spoor extension.

front.title: Plugin Types
front.body: What are the four main plugin types in Adapt?

back.title: Answer
back.body: Components (display + question), Extensions, Themes, and Menus.

front.title: Accessibility
front.body: What accessibility standard does Adapt meet?

back.title: Answer
back.body: Adapt meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards, with support for ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and screen readers.
